description: 과학기술정보통신부 우정사업본부_군사우체국 접수 및 배달 현황 [telecommunications] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 과학기술정보통신부 우정사업본부. 자료는 과학기술정보통신부 우정사업본부가 관리하는 전국 군사우체국의 2022년 접수 및 배달 물량 현황을 정리한 것으로, 지방우정청별·우체국별 관할 군사출장소의 물류 실적이 포함되어. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 과학기술정보통신부 우정사업본부. Its tags are 군사우체국, 지방우정청 관할 분포, 우편물 접수물량, 우편물 배달물량, 출장소별 실적. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-07-31 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
